A5RT FrameworkALGO5THM / A5RT
PHILOSOPHY
PROTECT → QUALIFY → EXECUTE. Trading isn't about being right all the time. It's about managing risk, following a process and letting probability work in your favour.
Core Principles
01Capital preservation precedes opportunity.
02Higher-timeframe context determines the trading environment.
03Liquidity provides the location.
04Market structure provides confirmation.
05Risk determines position size.
06Execution should be repeatable.
07Every trade becomes data for improving the process.

Entry Hierarchy
H4 CONTEXT → MODEL → DIRECTION → ARC/LOCATION → M3 SIM → EXECUTION
Neither Prime Flow nor ARC automatically triggers an entry. The M3 SIM + body break is the required execution trigger for all models. Touching ARC High/Low, H4 ML, or structure is never an entry signal in isolation.

Execution ProtocolA5RT v1.0 · DATA-DERIVED RULES
PROTECT→ QUALIFY→ EXECUTE
Hard Stop RulesZERO TOLERANCE
01
No trades outside A5RT qualification
Grade A+ before entry — not after. If you cannot grade it A+ before pulling the trigger, do not take it.
SOURCE: 8 NO SETUP/X = −5.28R · 0% win rate
02
No ARC re-entries after a failed first entry
ARC is session-scoped. Failed first entry = context consumed. No re-entry until next session's ARC forms.
SOURCE: ARC R.ENTRY = 0/5 wins · −6.12R total
03
Never delete a valid set limit order
Once placed on a valid A+ setup, the order stays until it triggers or the setup is structurally invalidated. Anxiety is not structural invalidation.
SOURCE: Documented: 1:20R and 1:49.91R missed opportunities
04
Maximum 2 trades per day
2 trades executed = session closed. No exceptions. No "high conviction" overrides.
SOURCE: Defined risk model · overtrading mechanism in C3/C4 spiral
05
Daily stop at −2%
If daily drawdown reaches −2%, session closes immediately. No revenge trades. No "last one."
SOURCE: Defined risk model
